_doc: Sprocket companion + Super Sprocket Protocol tuning. Source: updateSprocket 3956, setSprocketExpr 3900, sprocketPulse 3906, barkTry/updateBarks 11280-11298, superActivate 4016, updateSuperSprocket 4050, damageEnemy 5300 (index.html).

follow._src: updateSprocket: offset (-0.78, 1.85, -0.3) in Bolt's facing frame from the feet, bob sin(t*2.4)*0.09, lerp damp 6. The remake uses a spring (stiffness/damping) for the same target.

moods._src: setSprocketExpr / sprocketPulse: damage -> alarmed 1.6 s; bolts -> happy 2 s; bark -> smug 3 s; super -> alarmed for the protocol

super._combo_note: GDD §3.3: the meter also fills from combo tier. [min combo hits, multiplier on the damage fill]. BoltMelee already adds 0.012 per mallet combo hit.

mode_pick._doc: GDD section 3.3 modes picked from the situation: Bulwark when Bolt is hurting, Zip in a crowd, Overclock otherwise (all three implemented in M3, DECISIONS T-029).

bulwark._doc: Shield and taunt: Sprocket hovers between Bolt and the nearest threat; Bolt takes damage_taken_mult of every hit, regenerates heal_per_s, and enemy shots within deny_radius of Bolt are knocked out of the air.

zip._doc: Dashes between enemies: every hop_interval Sprocket rams the next mark, dealing hop_damage (x the super damage_mult) to everything within hop_radius on arrival.
